{{Otheruses|Liberator}}
The '''''Liberator''''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] that attempted to defect to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] near the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]]. The [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] exited [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] a complete wreck, with no survivors. While possible that the ship suffered a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] malfunction, rumors circulated that the vessel had been deliberately sabotaged by undercover agents to prevent its defection.
